_comment: Competitor registry for the full Competitor Intelligence section. Superseded from the earlier 10-vendor 'radar' stub now that this backs a dedicated section, not just a customer-radar cross-check. Grounded in Backbase's own public positioning content (backbase.com/blog comparison guides: 'Backbase vs Temenos', 'Backbase vs Salesforce', 'Q2 Holdings vs Backbase', 'Temenos vs Avaloq vs Backbase', 'Backbase vs Jack Henry'; backbase.com/press Kasisto acquisition) plus the internal competitive-landscape reference at https://backbase.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ID/pages/2693857362/Competitors (cited for context only — not queried at runtime from this external n8n workflow). Re-validate every quarterly audit; this market moves fast and every vendor listed here is shipping agentic-AI features on a roughly monthly cadence as of mid-2026. 2026-09-24: SME/Commercial coverage patch (Jarno) added Infosys Finacle to cross_cutting, six commercial vendors plus four 'See' pointers under by_lob.sme_commercial, and a two-pass pointer resolver in load-competitor-watchlist.js so Alkami/Lumin Digital 'See retail' pointers no longer silently no-op.
monitoring_method: https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=<url-encoded query>&hl=en&gl=US&ceid=US:en — same technique proven for customer-bank monitoring. No vendor here publishes a usable newsroom RSS (verified during the Sprint 1 audit), so Google News query is the primary channel; a few also get picked up incidentally via the Tier 1 industry RSS feeds (Finextra, Banking Dive, American Banker) — Phase 2 extraction tags those as competitive_angle regardless of which channel surfaced them.

note_on_kasisto: Kasisto (conversational/agentic AI for banking) was ACQUIRED BY Backbase in June 2026 (backbase.com/press/backbase-acquires-kasisto-leading-the-industry-shift-to-agentic-banking) and must NOT be tracked as a competitor going forward. It is retained here only as a note because 'Kasisto alternatives' search traffic still surfaces in some feeds — the Phase 1 triage prompt should treat Kasisto mentions as Backbase-relevant M&A/product news, not competitive intelligence.
